items.lede: The postponement of the IPO will delay some of the company's plans for its proceeds from the IPO, as well as those of its shareholders.
items.title: Oura shelves its $2.2B IPO citing ‘uncertainty’ in the market

items.lede: Researchers say the IPO market was off to a solid start but tailed off in the third quarter Smart ring maker Oura Inc says it is postponing a planned initial public offering due to market “uncertainty”. In a Tuesday press release, Oura said it’s delaying the stock market float “despite strong demand”. Continue reading...
items.title: Smart ring maker Oura puts off initial public offering due to market ‘uncertainty’
